calculateurs.title: Calculators
calculateurs.description: Convert a pace, estimate a finish time, set your zones: every tool computes on your device.

hub.seoDescription: Running calculators: training zones, race paces, treadmill converter, split generator, VMA estimation.

zones.seoDescription: Calculate your 6 heart rate and pace training zones from VMA or max HR. Free tool to personalize your running zones with FC ranges and pace targets.
zones.seoAppDescription: Calculate your 6 heart rate and pace training zones from your VMA or max HR
zones.title: Training zones calculator
zones.description: Enter your max heart rate or vVO2max: the six zones, their heart-rate ranges and their target paces follow.
zones.figuresLabel: The six zones drawn: the same runner from a walk to a sprint, and under each figure its zone, with your pace or heart-rate range once your numbers are known.
zones.thresholdPace: above {{pace}} you cross the threshold: the debt climbs faster than the pace
zones.thresholdHr: above {{bpm}} bpm you cross the threshold: lactate builds up faster than it clears

paces.seoDescription: Race pace calculator: estimate your finish times from 5K to marathon based on VMA. Convert speed to pace with predicted race times for every distance.
paces.seoAppDescription: Estimate your race times from 5K to marathon based on your VMA
paces.title: Race pace calculator
paces.description: Enter your vVO2max: your predicted finish times from 5K to marathon are computed, pace by pace.

converter.seoDescription: Free pace converter for runners. Convert between min/km, km/h and min/mile in real time with automatic training zone detection based on your VMA.
converter.seoAppDescription: Convert between min/km, km/h and min/mile in real time
converter.title: Pace Converter
converter.description: Type in any field and the others update instantly.
converter.displayingUnits: Displaying in {{system}} units. Change in Settings.

vma.seoTitle: From a race time: MAS and equivalent race times
vma.seoDescription: Estimate your maximal aerobic speed and race times from 5 km to marathon using the Péronnet and Thibault model. Compare distances and set your training zones.
vma.title: VMA from Race Time
vma.seoAppDescription: Estimate your VMA from a recent race result
vma.description: Enter a recent race time to estimate your VMA (Maximal Aerobic Speed) and see your training zones.

ftp.seoDescription: Calculate your FTP (Functional Threshold Power) from a 20-minute or ramp test. Get your 7 Coggan power zones to structure your cycling workouts.
ftp.seoAppDescription: Estimate your FTP from a 20-min or ramp test
ftp.title: FTP Test
ftp.invalidPower: Power must be between 1 and {{max}} W.
ftp.description: Enter the result of a power test to estimate your FTP (Functional Threshold Power). Coggan zones are derived from it.
ftp.protocol20minHelp: Average power over a maximal 20-minute effort. FTP ≈ 0.95 × 20-min power.
ftp.protocolRampHelp: Average power of the last full minute before failure. FTP ≈ 0.75 × final-minute power.

css.seoDescription: Calculate your CSS (Critical Swim Speed) from a 400m + 200m test. Get your swim pace zones to structure your sessions.
css.seoAppDescription: Estimate your CSS from a 400m + 200m test
css.title: CSS Test
css.invalidOrder: The 400 m must be slower than the 200 m. Fix one of the two times.
css.description: Enter your 400m and 200m times to estimate your CSS (Critical Swim Speed) and your swim pace zones.
css.protocolHelp: Swim a 400m all-out, recover 5-10 min, then swim a 200m all-out. CSS = (400 − 200) ÷ (t400 − t200), reported as seconds per 100m.

splits.seoDescription: Split generator for runners: plan per-km race splits for your target time. Even, negative, or positive split strategies from 5K to marathon distances.
splits.seoAppDescription: Generate per-km splits for your target race time with even, negative, or positive split strategies
splits.title: Split Generator
splits.description: Plan your race splits to reach your target time.
splits.evenDesc: All splits at the same pace.
splits.emptyState: Enter a distance and target time to generate your splits.

equivalence.seoDescription: Race time equivalence across distances, 5K to marathon, with the Péronnet-Thibault model, the same one that gives your vVO2max. Free.
equivalence.seoAppDescription: Predict your race times across all distances from a recent result
equivalence.title: Race Equivalence
equivalence.description: Enter a race result to predict your times across all standard distances.
equivalence.modelExplanation: Péronnet and Thibault model (1989), intermediate profile: the time entered gives a vVO2max, the vVO2max gives the other times. Same model as the vVO2max page, so the two cannot disagree.

paceTable.seoDescription: Complete pace reference table from 3:00 to 10:00/km with speed zones and estimated race times for 5K, 10K, half-marathon and marathon distances.
paceTable.seoAppDescription: Complete pace reference table from 3:00 to 10:00/km with estimated race times
paceTable.title: Pace Reference Table
paceTable.subtitle: All paces from 3:00 to 10:00/km with estimated race times.
paceTable.highlightNote: The highlighted row is closest to your 100% VMA pace.

treadmill.seoDescription: Treadmill pace converter: calculate equivalent outdoor pace from treadmill speed and incline. Includes training zone detection for your running effort.
treadmill.seoAppDescription: Convert treadmill speed and incline to equivalent outdoor pace
treadmill.title: Treadmill Converter
treadmill.description: Convert treadmill speed and incline to equivalent outdoor pace.
treadmill.configureVma: Configure your VMA in My Zones to see the training zone.
treadmill.formula: The formula accounts for the lack of air resistance and incline effect. A 1% incline roughly compensates for indoor running. Each additional 1% incline adds approximately 3% to the effort.
treadmill.outOfRange: Speed between 4 and 25 km/h, incline between 0 and 15%.

shared.title: Shared workout
shared.subtitle: Someone sent you this session. Add it to your workouts to edit or export it.
shared.invalid: The link is incomplete, most likely cut short when copied. Your saved workouts are untouched.

rows.vma: one result → your vVO2max and times

zones.title: Zones
zones.hintFree: VMA and max HR place your six zones.
zones.hintNoHr: Without max HR, no heart-rate ranges.
zones.why: Pace: 50-60, 60-75, 75-85, 85-92, 92-100 and 100-120 % of your VMA. Heart rate: 10 % bands of your max HR, from 50 to 110 %.

tapis.title: Treadmill
tapis.sayVma: {{kmh}} km/h on the flat, {{pct}} % of your VMA: {{zone}}.
tapis.setVma: Set your VMA to place it.
tapis.sayTreadmill: At {{incline}} % incline, to run this pace outside.
tapis.why: Each % of incline adds about 3 % of effort: the treadmill speed is multiplied by 1 + 0.03 × incline. The calculation does not account for the lack of wind on a treadmill.

allures.title: Paces
allures.label: Pace
allures.noVma: Set your vVO2max to place this pace in your zones.
allures.hint: Tap a value to type it: the others follow.
allures.why: A pace is a time per kilometre. Speed in km/h is 60 divided by the pace in minutes. A mile is 1.609344 km, so the mile pace is the km pace times 1.609344. The % of vVO2max is the speed divided by your vVO2max. The time over a distance is the pace times that distance, with no slowing down: fatigue is not in it.

table.lede: Every pace from 3:00 to 10:00/km, with the matching race times.

chrono.title: From a race time
chrono.seoTitle: From a race time: MAS and equivalent race times
chrono.seoDescription: Estimate your maximal aerobic speed and race times from 5 km to marathon using the Péronnet and Thibault model. Compare distances and set your training zones.
chrono.seoAppName: MAS and equivalent race time calculator
chrono.say: Over {{time}}, you sustained {{percent}}% of your MAS.
chrono.aboveVma: That is {{delta}} above the value you set ({{vma}}).
chrono.belowVma: That is {{delta}} below the value you set ({{vma}}).
chrono.equalVma: That matches the value you set ({{vma}}).
chrono.noVma: You have not set your MAS yet.
chrono.zonesChange: Your zones would move by a few seconds: threshold {{before}} → {{next}}/km.
chrono.zonesNew: Your zones would follow this MAS: threshold {{next}}/km.
chrono.unsavable: Saved values accept a MAS between 8 and 30 km/h.
chrono.elsewhere: What it means at other distances
chrono.provenance: Péronnet and Thibault model, intermediate profile. The same model gives your MAS and race times, so they cannot contradict each other.

splits.title: Splits
splits.summary: Start at {{first}}, finish at {{last}}. Halfway in {{halfway}}.
splits.summaryEven: Hold {{first}} from start to finish. Halfway in {{halfway}}.
splits.empty: Set a distance and your goal to see your splits.
splits.startHint: Optional, local time in h:mm format.
splits.provenance: Even splits hold a constant pace. Negative splits decrease time per kilometre linearly from +2% to -2% around average pace (the reverse for positive splits), then all times are scaled proportionally to meet the exact goal, including the final partial kilometre.
